# Subway Seat for AIChat

AIChat reads `dark.tmTheme` or `light.tmTheme` from its config directory, so each flavor ships under the name AIChat looks for. Walnut and Tunnel are both dark; keep the one you like.

[AIChat](https://github.com/sigoden/aichat) · [All ports and previews](https://oddurs.github.io/subway-seat/ports/aichat/)

## Files

| Flavor | File | Where it goes |
|---|---|---|
| Subway Seat | [`subway-seat/dark.tmTheme`](subway-seat/dark.tmTheme) | ~/.config/aichat/dark.tmTheme |
| Subway Seat Tunnel | [`subway-seat-tunnel/dark.tmTheme`](subway-seat-tunnel/dark.tmTheme) | ~/.config/aichat/dark.tmTheme |
| Subway Seat Enamel | [`subway-seat-enamel/light.tmTheme`](subway-seat-enamel/light.tmTheme) | ~/.config/aichat/light.tmTheme |

## Turn it on

In aichat's config.yaml (`aichat --info` shows the config dir):

```yaml
theme: dark   # light for Subway Seat Enamel
```


Generated by `build.py` from `palette.py`. Edit the port in `ports/`, not these files.
